verses.original: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־ בְּתוּלָֽה׃
verses.literal: I have made a covenant with my eyes How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin

verses.original: וּמֶ֤ה׀ חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·meh ḥê·leq ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mim·mā·‘al wə·na·ḥă·laṯ šad·dai mim·mə·rō·mîm
verses.literal: For what is the allotment of God from above or the heritage from the Almighty on high

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.literal: Does not disaster come to the unjust and calamity to the workers of iniquity

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל־ צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- hū yir·’eh ḏə·rā·ḵāy wə·ḵāl ṣə·‘ā·ḏay yis·pō·wr
verses.literal: Does He not see my ways and count my every step

verses.original: אִם־ הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־ שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־ מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃
verses.literal: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit

verses.original: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־ צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
verses.literal: let God weigh me with honest scales that He may know my integrity

verses.original: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’im tiṭ·ṭeh ’aš·šu·rî min·nî had·dā·reḵ wə·’a·ḥar ‘ê·nay hā·laḵ lib·bî ū·ḇə·ḵap·pay dā·ḇaq mu·ʾūm
verses.literal: If my steps have turned from the path if my heart has followed . . . my eyes or if impurity has stuck to my hands

verses.original: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.literal: then may another eat what I have sown and may my crops be uprooted

verses.original: אִם־ נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל־ אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל־ פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.literal: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife or I have lurked at his door

verses.original: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃
verses.literal: then may my own wife grind grain for another and may other men sleep with her

verses.original: כִּי־ הוּא זִמָּ֑ה וְהִיא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.literal: For that would be a heinous crime an iniquity to be judged

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד־ אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל־ תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’êš hî ‘aḏ- ’ă·ḇad·dō·wn tō·ḵêl ū·ḇə·ḵāl tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯî ṯə·šā·rêš
verses.literal: For it is a fire that burns down to Abaddon it would root out my entire harvest

verses.original: אִם־ אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.literal: If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they made a complaint against me

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־ יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי־ יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kî- yā·qūm ’êl wə·ḵî- yip̄·qōḏ māh ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū
verses.literal: what will I do when God rises to judge How will I answer when called to account

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽ֝לֹא־ בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.literal: Did not He who made me in the womb also make them Did not the same One form us in the womb

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.literal: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail

verses.original: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא־ אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·ḵal pit·tî lə·ḇad·dî wə·lō- ’ā·ḵal yā·ṯō·wm mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: if I have eaten my morsel alone not sharing it with the fatherless

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.literal: though from my youth I reared him as would a father and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow

verses.original: אִם־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: if I have seen one perish for lack of clothing or a needy man without a cloak

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חֲלָצוֹ וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ḇê·ră·ḵū·nî ḥă·lå̄·ṣō ū·mig·gêz kə·ḇā·śay yiṯ·ḥam·mām
verses.literal: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep

verses.original: אִם־ הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל־ יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־ אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.literal: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate

verses.original: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯê·p̄î miš·šiḵ·māh ṯip·pō·wl wə·’ez·rō·‘î miq·qā·nāh ṯiš·šā·ḇêr
verses.literal: then may my arm fall from my shoulder and be torn from its socket

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.literal: For calamity from God terrifies me and His splendor I cannot overpower

verses.original: אִם־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃
verses.literal: If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי־ רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־ כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’eś·maḥ kî- raḇ ḥê·lî wə·ḵî- ḵab·bîr mā·ṣə·’āh yā·ḏî
verses.literal: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much

verses.original: אִם־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.literal: if I have beheld the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor

verses.original: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄t bas·sê·ṯer lib·bî wat·tiš·šaq yā·ḏî lə·p̄î
verses.literal: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth

verses.original: גַּם־ ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־ כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- hū ‘ā·wōn pə·lî·lî kî- ḵi·ḥaš·tî lā·’êl mim·mā·‘al
verses.literal: this would also be an iniquity to be judged for I would have denied God on high

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־ מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’eś·maḥ bə·p̄îḏ mə·śan·’î wə·hiṯ·‘ō·rar·tî kî- mə·ṣā·’ōw rā‘
verses.literal: If I have rejoiced in my enemy’s ruin or exulted when evil befell him

verses.original: וְלֹא־ נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- nā·ṯat·tî la·ḥă·ṭō ḥik·kî liš·’ōl bə·’ā·lāh nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ’ā·mə·rū mə·ṯê ’ā·ho·lî mî- yit·tên mib·bə·śā·rōw lō niś·bā‘
verses.literal: if the men of my house have not said Who is there . . . who has not had his fill

verses.original: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־ יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥūṣ lō- yā·lîn gêr də·lā·ṯay lā·’ō·raḥ ’ep̄·tāḥ
verses.literal: but no stranger had to lodge on the street for my door has been open to the traveler

verses.original: אִם־ כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי׃
verses.literal: if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ׀ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז־ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־ אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’e·‘ĕ·rō·wṣ hā·mō·wn rab·bāh ū·ḇūz- miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ yə·ḥit·tê·nî wā·’ed·dōm lō- ’ê·ṣê p̄ā·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: because I greatly feared the crowds and the contempt of the clans terrified me so that I kept silent and would not go outside . . .

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־ לִ֨י׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־ תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·ten- lî šō·mê·a‘ lî hen- tā·wî šad·day ya·‘ă·nê·nî wə·sê·p̄er kā·ṯaḇ ’îš rî·ḇî
verses.literal: Oh, that I had one to hear me Here is my signature Let the Almighty answer me let my accuser . . . compose an indictment

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א עַל־ שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.literal: Surely . . . I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown

verses.original: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־ נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.literal: I would give account of all my steps I would approach Him like a prince

verses.original: אִם־ עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.literal: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together

verses.original: אִם־ כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי־ כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kō·ḥāh ’ā·ḵal·tî ḇə·lî- ḵā·sep̄ wə·ne·p̄eš bə·‘ā·le·hā hip·pā·ḥə·tî
verses.literal: if I have devoured its produce without payment or broken the spirit . . . of its tenants

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה׀ יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת־ שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃פ
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ḥiṭ·ṭāh yê·ṣê ḥō·w·aḥ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ- śə·‘ō·rāh ḇā·’ə·šāh tam·mū diḇ·rê ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: then let briers grow instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley Thus conclude the words of Job
